name: ERES
band_note: mean of blouse entry $445 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band (swim and lingerie house; resortwear reads True Luxury)
why: Women's swimwear, lingerie, resortwear and loungewear made by a Paris studio, swim pieces mostly $235–$375, sold through its own boutiques, website and department stores.

quote.q: Impeccable cuts, exclusive materials, and custom-made color palettes : each piece is designed to embrace the body and offer unparalleled freedom of movement.

opview: “Impeccable cuts, exclusive materials, and custom-made color palettes : each piece is designed to embrace the body and offer unparalleled freedom of movement.” — ERES (house), The House of ERES, eresparis.com
